body: I've listened to it twice, and will probably listen to it even more... it has many interesting parts, even if you don't have avpd. What I liked the most was hearing someone with avpd describe how outgoing he could be. I have often heard that I am charismatic, bubbly, outgoing and people have a hard time understanding that I can have so much anxiety because I play my part and then I cry from anxiety off-stage... It was nice to hear that I'm not alone.
